summary: Round r1 (restricted network). Primary documents for Nepal's multilateral financing arrangements were located as source leads: the IMF ECF arrangement (fourth to seventh reviews, the 2026 extension request and the combined 2026 Article IV / seventh review staff report), the World Bank Group CPF FY2025-2031, the ADB CPS 2025-2029 with linked documents and board chair summary, AIIB approved project pages, and the Ministry of Finance AMIS partner profile (tier 1) for cross-checking. No values were retrieved; envelopes, disbursements, conditionality and dates are pending. Lead titles indicate the IMF ECF reached its final review in 2026; whether a successor IMF arrangement is sought is unknown (no lead). Policy-matrix documents for any active DPF/PBL operations and IDA/ADF terms were not located.

findings.claim: Q1 IMF: status, remaining disbursements and conditionality of the ECF arrangement at completion, and whether any successor IMF arrangement or Policy Coordination Instrument has been requested.
findings.note: Retrieve CR 2026/127 (A01-A03), extension request (A06/A08) and press releases (A04, A07); record access (SDR, percent of quota), disbursement schedule, QPC/IT/SB tables. No lead located for a successor arrangement - status unknown.

findings.claim: Q1 World Bank: CPF FY2025-2031 indicative envelope, instrument mix and IDA terms applicable to Nepal; active portfolio commitments.
findings.note: CPF document A14 (envelope table, results framework); active project list via A15; note World Bank FY (July-June) differs from Nepal FY (mid-July).

findings.claim: Q1 ADB: CPS 2025-2029 indicative resource envelope split concessional/regular and by modality; active loans, grants and policy-based lending conditions.
findings.note: CPS A16, linked documents A17/A18, chair summary A19, project list via A20. ADB uses calendar year.

findings.claim: Q1 AIIB: approved sovereign and non-sovereign financing for Nepal and project status.
findings.note: Approved project pages A21-A25; cross-check commitment/disbursement with MoF AMIS A26 (Nepal FY).

findings.claim: Q1 Policy conditions: prior actions and triggers in any active World Bank DPF/PforR and ADB policy-based loans.
findings.note: Programme documents for DPF/PBL operations not yet located as direct files; required: DPF programme document policy matrix and ADB PBL report and recommendation of the President (RRP) policy matrix.

findings.claim: Q1 Concessionality: current IDA and ADF terms applicable to Nepal and any change triggered by LDC graduation or income classification.
findings.note: IDA terms table (IDA21) and ADB concessional assistance eligibility policy; no lead located in r1. Note LDC graduation does not by itself determine IDA/ADF eligibility (eligibility is GNI-per-capita and creditworthiness based) - to confirm from policy documents.

findings.claim: Programme register records each arrangement once per institution with: instrument, approval date, end date, envelope (committed vs disbursed kept separate), currency (SDR, USD), conditionality type, and the source's fiscal-year basis. Envelopes in strategies (CPF, CPS) are indicative and are never summed with committed project amounts.

Where MoF AMIS (tier 1) and institution portals (tier 2) differ on commitments/disbursements, both are kept; typical causes are fiscal-year basis (Nepal FY vs WB FY vs CY), exchange-rate conversion date and on-budget vs off-budget recording.

data_gaps: Successor IMF arrangement or PCI after ECF completion - no lead located.
World Bank active portfolio list (projects.worldbank.org export) and DPF programme documents not located as direct files.
ADB active project list and PBL policy matrices not located as direct files.
IDA21 terms and ADB concessional eligibility policy documents not located.
Other development-finance arrangements (NDB not applicable; EIB, IsDB, OPEC Fund, JICA, EXIM China/India lines of credit) not covered in r1 - require MoF AMIS/PDMO creditor lists.
MoF Development Cooperation Report latest FY not located (search budget exhausted).

assumptions.text: Strategy envelopes (CPF, CPS) are indicative planning figures and are recorded separately from approved commitments and from disbursements.
All amounts are recorded in the reporting currency of the source (SDR, USD) with the conversion date; no cross-institution totals are formed without a documented FY and FX conversion.

challenges.text: Proposed EXP entry on multilateral creditor concentration should draw on A14/A16 envelopes only as forward-looking indicative figures; creditor stock shares must come from PDMO and IDS, not from strategy documents.
MoF AMIS (amis2.mof.gov.np) is a tier-1 source for aid commitments/disbursements by partner and is missing from the source catalog; lead A26 carries source_id null.

uncertainty: High. No programme value is retrieved. Status statements rest on document titles only (e.g. ECF extension and final review in 2026) and must be verified from the documents. The existence of any successor IMF engagement is unknown. Strategy envelopes are indicative and subject to IDA/ADF replenishment outcomes and performance-based allocation.
